title: Goal-Guided Reinforcement Learning via Fine-Tuning Vision-Language Models
title_zh: 通过微调视觉语言模型实现目标引导的强化学习
abstract_en: Exploration remains a major challenge for reinforcement learning (RL) agents in Craftax-style environments due to sparse rewards and long horizons. Large language models (LLMs) can guide exploration by generating high-level goals, but methods using models without explicit task adaptation often rely on carefully designed prompts and may produce inconsistent or contextually inappropriate goals. We introduce CCGP-2M, a multimodal goal-preference dataset constructed from interaction trajectories in Craftax-Classic, and propose a vision-language model (VLM)-guided RL framework that learns environment-specific goal guidance from this dataset. The framework consists of two stages: offline VLM fine-tuning and online goal-guided RL. In the offline stage, we align the VLM with goal preferences using Kullback-Leibler Token-level Direct Preference Optimization (KLTDPO), which combines token-level KL regularization with distributionally robust reweighting. Experiments on Craftax-Classic show that our method collects diamonds earlier than state-of-the-art baselines, achieves the highest score and reward, and attains the highest success rates on most achievements.
abstract_zh: 在 Craftax 类环境中，奖励稀疏、任务跨度长，使强化学习（RL）智能体难以有效探索。大语言模型（LLM）可以生成高层目标来引导探索，但未经任务适配的模型往往依赖精心设计的提示词，生成的目标也可能不一致或不符合当前情境。本文基于 Craftax-Classic 的交互轨迹构建了多模态目标偏好数据集 CCGP-2M，并提出一个两阶段框架：先离线微调视觉语言模型（VLM），再用微调后的模型生成目标，引导在线强化学习。离线阶段采用 KLTDPO（Kullback-Leibler Token-level Direct Preference Optimization），结合 token 级 KL 正则化与分布鲁棒重加权，使模型与目标偏好对齐。在 Craftax-Classic 实验中，该方法比最先进的基线更早采集到钻石，取得最高的得分和奖励，并在大多数成就上达到最高成功率。
key_points_zh: 从 Craftax-Classic 的交互轨迹构建 CCGP-2M，为模型学习符合当前情境的高层目标提供多模态偏好数据。
采用离线微调、在线引导的两阶段框架，让 VLM 学习适合当前环境的目标，而不是仅依赖提示词。
KLTDPO 将 token 级 KL 正则化与分布鲁棒重加权结合，用于目标偏好对齐。
在 Craftax-Classic 上，该方法比基线更早采集到钻石，得分和奖励最高，并在大多数成就上取得最高成功率。

agent-harness-evolution.reason: 用交互轨迹构建目标偏好并更新引导模型参数，以改善智能体探索；整体基线比较支持效果，但未分离各训练组件的贡献。
